items.title: Infrastructure and deployment
items.description: Containerization with Docker, VPS server setup, domains, SSL and deployment pipelines on AWS, Azure or Cloudflare.

bullets: Building enterprise web solutions with Nuxt.js / Vue.js on the frontend, integrated with backend services and APIs within a modular, scalable architecture.
Developing reusable frontend components and interfaces focused on maintainability, usability and performance for business-critical applications.
Integrating frontend applications with RESTful services and backend systems, handling data exchange through JSON structures.
Containerizing applications and standardizing development and deployment environments with Docker.
Working with enterprise systems spanning HR, CRM, accounting and operations modules.
Led the rollout of Electronic Invoicing (DGII) across multiple environments, coordinating application, database and infrastructure requirements.
Administered SAP Business One on Linux servers (openSUSE) and supported production environments with a focus on operational continuity.
Handled infrastructure maintenance, daily system monitoring and SLA-based technical support.
Built advanced SQL solutions, including stored procedures, views, data cubes and reports with SAP Crystal Reports.
Built an end-to-end logistics platform with React on the frontend and Laravel (PHP) on the backend.
Full-stack apps and automated messaging bots integrating the WhatsApp Business API and Meta Suite, with Python on the backend.
Websites and online stores with WordPress, Elementor and WooCommerce, including custom PHP templates.
Financial process automation with Google Apps Script and end-to-end infrastructure management: AWS, Azure, Hostinger, Cloudflare, VPS servers with Apache, DNS and SSL certificates.
